zh: 一旦决定保留某个类别，就应该保留它的全部商品；要删除的只是没被保留的类别里的所有商品。
删得最少就是保留得最多：在至多 k 个类别里选商品总数最大的组合，自然就是出现次数最多的 k 个类别。
统计每个类别的出现次数，降序排序，取前 k 个之和作为保留数（不足 k 类就全部保留），输出 n − 保留数。
en: Once you decide to keep a category, keep all of its products; the deletions are exactly the products of the categories you do not keep.
Deleting the fewest means keeping the most: among sets of at most k categories, the one with the most products is simply the k most frequent categories.
Count how often each category appears, sort the counts descending, keep the sum of the first k (all of them if there are fewer than k categories), and print n minus that sum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the category frequencies in descending order, keep the k most frequent categories and delete everything else.

## Proof of correctness

For a fixed set of kept categories, keeping every product of those categories is never worse. If a lower-frequency category is kept while a higher-frequency one is dropped, swapping them increases the number kept, so the optimum keeps the at most k most frequent categories.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
